comments.value: Yes please. I'm tired of video players breaking due to youtube-dl going out of date and then the dev team taking an absurdly long amount of time to update youtube-dl again. Sometimes it gets to the point where people aren't able to watch any youtube videos for weeks at a time. It also affects any club worlds that use youtube videos for music, effectively making those worlds useless for weeks.

details:
Having the ability for YouTube-DL to auto-update would be great, however, I'm aware of the security risks. What is the youtube-dl github got hijacked and malicious software was distributed? etc.

A solution to this would be to have the client compare the file against one on VRChat's own servers, then download if it is different.
This allows VRChat to update the youtube-dl file on the fly without having to push a whole new game update to Steam. :)
title: Auto-update Youtube-DL from VRChat's servers
